question:
Which of the following pairs of "Himalayas - feature" is correct?

I. Kumaon Himalayas - lying between Satluj and Kali rivers

II. Nepal Himalayas - lying between Teesta and Dihang rivers
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only I.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

The Himalayas have also been divided on the basis of regions from west to east.

These are Punjab Himalayas, Kumaon Himalaya, Nepal Himalayas, and Assa
